message.content:
**Estimated price of a Tesla Model S in India**

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Base U.S. price (Long‑Range)** | ≈ $90 000 (USD) |
| **Current USD→INR rate** | ≈ ₹75 per $1 (mid‑2026) |
| **Converted price** | ≈ ₹6.75 million |
| **Typical import duties & taxes** | 20–30 % (GST, customs, excise, etc.) |
| **Final retail estimate** | ≈ ₹8.5–9 million INR |

> **Bottom line:** A Tesla Model S would likely retail in India for roughly **₹8.5 – 9 million** (about **$115 000–$120 000**), depending on the exact configuration and any future changes in duty rates or local incentives.

> **Why this estimate?**  
> 1. **Base price** – Tesla’s U.S. Long‑Range Model S starts at about $90 k.  
> 2. **Currency conversion** – Using the mid‑2026 USD‑INR rate (~₹75).  
> 3. **Import duties** – India imposes high import duties on EVs (≈ 20 % customs + 18 % GST + other levies).  
> 4. **Local taxes** – Additional state‑level taxes and fees can add another 5–10 %.  

> **Note:** Tesla has not yet launched the Model S in India, so the actual launch price could differ once the company finalizes its pricing strategy and local supply chain costs.
